:::{#exr-rss-gradient-vector}
#### Gradient of RSS in vector notation

Find the gradient of the residual sum of squares in vector notation (@exm-rss-vector),
$\deriv{\vcoef} \text{RSS}(\vcoef)$,
by differentiating with respect to the vector $\vcoef$ directly,
rather than one component at a time.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-rss-gradient-vector}

Differentiate one operation at a time,
starting from $\text{RSS}(\vcoef)$ in vector notation (@exm-rss-vector):

$$
\begin{aligned}
\deriv{\vcoef} \text{RSS}(\vcoef)
&= \deriv{\vcoef} \sumin \paren{y_i - \dprod{\vxi}{\vcoef}}^2
&& \text{(RSS in vector form)}\\
&= \sumin \deriv{\vcoef} \paren{y_i - \dprod{\vxi}{\vcoef}}^2
&& \text{(derivative of a sum)}\\
&= \sumin 2 \paren{y_i - \dprod{\vxi}{\vcoef}}
  \deriv{\vcoef} \paren{y_i - \dprod{\vxi}{\vcoef}}
&& \text{(chain rule)}
\end{aligned}
$$

For the inner derivative, we need the gradient of a linear function.
For any constant vector $\va = \tp{(a_0, a_x)}$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\deriv{\vcoef} \dprod{\va}{\vcoef}
&= \deriv{\vcoef} \paren{a_0 \intcoef + a_x \coef{x}}
&& \text{(write out the dot product)}\\
&= \begin{pmatrix}
  \deriv{\intcoef} \paren{a_0 \intcoef + a_x \coef{x}} \\
  \frac{\partial}{\partial \coef{x}} \paren{a_0 \intcoef + a_x \coef{x}}
  \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(definition of the gradient)}\\
&= \begin{pmatrix} a_0 + 0 \\ 0 + a_x \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(derivative of each term)}\\
&= \begin{pmatrix} a_0 \\ a_x \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(add zero)}\\
&= \va
&& \text{(definition of $\va$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

With $\va = \vxi$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\deriv{\vcoef} \paren{y_i - \dprod{\vxi}{\vcoef}}
&= \deriv{\vcoef} y_i - \deriv{\vcoef} \dprod{\vxi}{\vcoef}
&& \text{(derivative of a difference)}\\
&= \vzero - \deriv{\vcoef} \dprod{\vxi}{\vcoef}
&& \text{($y_i$ does not depend on $\vcoef$)}\\
&= \vzero - \vxi
&& \text{(gradient of a linear function)}\\
&= -\vxi
&& \text{(subtract from zero)}
\end{aligned}
$$

Plugging the inner derivative back in:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\deriv{\vcoef} \text{RSS}(\vcoef)
&= \sumin 2 \paren{y_i - \dprod{\vxi}{\vcoef}} \paren{-\vxi}
&& \text{(inner derivative is $-\vxi$)}\\
&= \sumin 2 \paren{-\vxi} \paren{y_i - \dprod{\vxi}{\vcoef}}
&& \text{(reorder the scalar and vector factors)}\\
&= \sumin \paren{-2} \vxi \paren{y_i - \dprod{\vxi}{\vcoef}}
&& \text{($2 \paren{-\vxi} = -2 \vxi$)}\\
&= -2 \sumin \vxi \paren{y_i - \dprod{\vxi}{\vcoef}}
&& \text{(constant factor out of the sum)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
